title: Untrusted markup assigned to an HTML sink

peers.contract: disallows unsafe assignment to innerHTML and similar DOM properties

cases.label: request value into innerHTML
cases.why: Attacker-supplied markup reaches an HTML sink.

cases.label: the same through a computed key
cases.why: The same sink, spelled with brackets.

cases.label: the same through a template-literal key
cases.why: The same sink again; a no-substitution template IS a string.

cases.label: a string constant written in the source
cases.why: The markup is in the file; nobody outside chose it.

cases.label: textContent, which does not parse markup
cases.why: textContent is the documented safe sink.

cases.label: sanitised before assignment
cases.code:
import DOMPurify from 'dompurify';
function f(el, req) { el.innerHTML = DOMPurify.sanitize(req.query.q); }
cases.why: The documented fix. Reporting it leaves the user nothing to do.
